name: BIT Computer Co., Ltd
summary: Established in Seoul, South Korea, in 1983, BIT Computer Co., Ltd. is a specialist provider of diverse software solutions, primarily catering to the healthcare sector. Their comprehensive product suite includes a variety of hospital management systems, such as numerous Electronic Medical Record (EMR) platforms adapted for institutions ranging from small clinics to large hospitals and nursing facilities. These core offerings are enhanced by supplementary tools for tasks like insurance claim review, optimizing pharmaceutical prescriptions, intelligent nursing assistance, as well as hospital-specific enterprise resource planning (ERP) and customer relationship management (CRM) systems. The company also delivers solutions focused on patient and member engagement, encompassing cloud-based platforms, paperless clinic technology, medical image management, patient waiting systems with mobile notifications, pre-inspection services for insurance claims, and robust personal information security. Furthermore, BIT Computer provides specialized software for pharmacy management and a dedicated pharmaceutical portal. Their innovative digital health portfolio features non-contact medical services, advanced telemedicine systems, booth-based remote medical care, smart healthcare applications, employee health management tools, and medical device integration gateways.
